I have used a fairly large variety of spot patches and hydrocolloid based acne covers with mixed at best success. As with related products, I placed the Miracle Patches on problem areas after my p.m. skin care routine and left them on throughout the night. While I noticed a mild decrease in discoloration spots overall, the microcrystals were fairly uncomfortable during both application and removal. I imagine this is due to my sensitive skin's reaction to either the spiny texture of the microcrystals or the addition of succinic acid and tea tree oil on the patches. They may be fine for folks with more hearty skin than myself, but I have no interest irritating my skin with these further.
